name: @activepieces/piece-jogg-ai
description: AI-powered content creation platform for generating avatar photos, videos, and product content using advanced AI technology.

createAiAvatarPhoto.name: createAiAvatarPhoto
createAiAvatarPhoto.description: Creates an AI avatar photo using JoggAI API

age.description: The age group for the avatar

image_url.description: URL of an existing image to use as reference

aiMetadata.description: Generates a brand-new AI avatar photo on JoggAI from specified traits (age, gender, style, ethnicity, aspect ratio, model) plus optional appearance/background text or a reference image URL. Use to produce an avatar still image for downstream avatar-video creation. Not idempotent: each call generates and is billed for a new photo.

createAvatarVideo.name: createAvatarVideo
createAvatarVideo.description: Creates an avatar video using JoggAI API

script.description: Script content for the avatar to speak. Must provide either script or audio_url

audio_url.description: URL for audio. Must provide either script or audio_url

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the output video

aiMetadata.description: Starts generation of a talking-avatar video on JoggAI from a chosen avatar and voice, with the speech sourced either from a typed script OR from an audio URL (exactly one is required, never both). Use to turn a script or voiceover into a narrated avatar video; the call kicks off an async job whose output is polled via Get Generated Video or received through the video-generation triggers. Not idempotent: each call queues and is billed for a new video.

createProductFromUrl.name: createProductFromUrl
createProductFromUrl.description: Creates a product by crawling product information from a URL

url.description: URL of the product to crawl and extract information from

aiMetadata.description: Creates a JoggAI product by crawling a single product page URL and extracting its details automatically. Use when you have only a product page link and want JoggAI to derive the product info for you; choose Create Product from Product Info instead when you already have the name, description, or media to supply directly. Not idempotent: each call creates a new product record.

createProductFromProductInfo.name: createProductFromProductInfo
createProductFromProductInfo.description: Creates a product from product information

url.description: URL of the product to crawl for information

aiMetadata.description: Creates a JoggAI product from supplied details (name, description, target audience, and media items) and/or a product URL. Use when you already hold the product info to pass directly; at least one of a URL or some product info must be provided, otherwise the call is rejected. Not idempotent: each call creates a new product record.

updateProductInfo.name: updateProductInfo
updateProductInfo.description: Updates existing product information using product ID

product_id.description: Product ID obtained from product creation

target_audience.description: Updated target audience for the product

media.description: Updated media resources for the product (replaces existing media)

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing JoggAI product identified by its product_id, overwriting any supplied fields (name, description, target audience, media); supplied media replaces the product’s existing media rather than appending. Use to modify a product you already created; requires the product_id and at least one field to change. Idempotent: re-sending the same fields leaves the product in the same state.

getGeneratedVideo.name: getGeneratedVideo
getGeneratedVideo.description: Get information about a specific generated video project using its ID

project_id.description: The ID of the project to retrieve information for

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the current status and details of a JoggAI video project by its project_id. Use to poll an in-progress avatar/template video generation job for completion or to fetch the finished video URL. Idempotent: a read-only lookup with no side effects.

uploadMedia.name: uploadMedia
uploadMedia.description: Generate a signed URL for file upload. Use the returned sign_url to upload your file with a PUT request.

filename.description: Name of the file to upload with extension (e.g., "image.jpg", "video.mp4")

aiMetadata.description: Requests a signed upload URL from JoggAI for a given filename (must include a file extension and no special characters); the caller then PUTs the actual file bytes to the returned sign_url. Use as the first step to get media into JoggAI before referencing it in product or video actions. Not idempotent: each call mints a new signed upload target.

createVideoFromTemplate.name: createVideoFromTemplate
createVideoFromTemplate.description: Creates a new video from templates

variables.description: Variables to replace in the template

name.description: Name of the variable to replace (as defined in template)

aiMetadata.description: Starts generation of a JoggAI video from a template, choosing the template from either the common library or the user’s own templates, and filling in template variables (text/script content or image/video URLs) plus optional avatar, voice, captions, and music. Use to render a video off a predefined template rather than building one from scratch; the call queues an async job whose output is polled via Get Generated Video. Not idempotent: each call queues and is billed for a new video.

videoGeneratedSuccessfully.name: videoGeneratedSuccessfully
videoGeneratedSuccessfully.description: Fires when a video is generated successfully

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a JoggAI video generation job completes successfully, delivering the finished video’s project_id, video URL, and duration. Use to react to a completed avatar or template video without polling Get Generated Video.
Fires when a JoggAI video generation job fails, delivering the affected project_id and an error message. Use to detect and handle failed avatar or template video generations.

error.message: Video generation failed due to invalid parameters
